contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-products-prices-manage-prices-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-manage-products-prices-2025.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-products-prices.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/products-prices/manage-prices`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November 7 capture of https://docs.stripe.com/products-prices/manage-prices is a complete guide to managing Stripe Products and Prices through Dashboard and API. A merchant must add at least one Price to save a Product in the Dashboard, a separate condition from API creation and the import convention (old raw lines 36-38 and new raw lines 37-39). The merchant can set an active default and create a new Price to change the amount. Archival prevents adding the Product or Price to new invoices or subscriptions, but existing subscriptions stay active until cancellation. Both archive paragraphs describe deactivating existing Payment Links that use the Product (old raw lines 129-131 and 534-536; new raw lines 113-115 and 448-450). Dashboard can delete an unused Price, while Price deletion is unavailable through the API and a Product needs no associated Prices to qualify for deletion. A merchant can copy a sandbox Product and associated Prices to live mode more than once, producing a new live Product each time with no ongoing sync (new raw lines 591-595). April instead said once only (old raw lines 697-701). source-stripe-products-prices.md records that April rule and still supports the core price amount replacement logic (old raw lines 504-508). Its compatibility table needs to retain the explicit invoice-item currency path (new raw lines 354-362).
reviewed_answers.Q2: The substantive change at https://docs.stripe.com/products-prices/manage-prices is follow-on Dashboard sandbox copies: November describes repeated copies creating separate live Products and associated Prices, with no later sandbox updates to those copies; April said one copy (old raw lines 697-701 and new raw lines 591-595). The Node-to-curl examples, step numbering, wording and CLI link changes are presentational or navigational (old raw lines 12-16 and 65-100; new raw lines 13-17 and 67-88). Preserve the April one-time rule in dated history in source-stripe-products-prices.md and keep the scoped Product/Price deletion and edit-field tensions (old raw lines 174-180 and 520-532; new raw lines 150-176 and 438-446). Retain the separate April compatibility overview and qualify invoice-item currency explicitly. Preserve the root, Stripe index and company catalog routes and the source's existing Checkout Sessions source link. The Checkout concept's Price-ID context is relevant to a proposed direct reciprocal link, and catalog copying supplies no new Checkout behavior.
